face.name: 指挥官沃恩

face.flavorText: 指挥官这头衔听起来比幼龙保姆酷多了。

face.name: War Master Voone
face.text: Battlecry: Copy all Dragons in your hand.
face.flavorText: War Master sounds cooler than Dragon Sitter.

face.name: 亡语者女士
face.text: 亡语：复制你手牌中的所有冰霜法术牌。
face.flavorText: “嘘……死亡……芝士……煎蛋卷……”

face.name: Lady Deathwhisper
face.text: Deathrattle: Copy all Frost spells in your hand.
face.flavorText: "Psst... Omelette death fromage."

face.name: 扎依，出彩艺人
face.text: 战吼： 复制你手牌中最左边和最右边的牌。
face.flavorText: 接下来有请她的弟弟，平凡艺人扎尔。

face.name: Zai, the Incredible
face.text: Battlecry: Copy the left- and right-most cards in your hand.
face.flavorText: Following this act will be her younger brother, Frank the Mediocre.

face.name: 皮普，强力水霸
face.text: 战吼：复制你手牌中法力值消耗为 （1）的牌。
face.flavorText: 有一次，我发现危险的坏蛋切瑞·欧列就在皮普的身边，可我最终只喊出了“皮普！皮普！欧——”

face.name: Pip the Potent
face.text: Battlecry: Copy each 1-Cost card in your hand.
face.flavorText: One time, I was trying to get Pip's attention to warn her that the dangerous outlaw Cheery Ollie, who also goes by just 'O', was headed her way. "Pip! Pip! Cheery O!", I shouted.

face.name: 传令官沃拉兹
face.text: 战吼：召唤所有其他友方随从的复制，他们均为1/1。
face.flavorText: 作为传令官他的工作其实很简单，就是整天吆喝：“尤格-萨隆要来啦！”

face.name: Herald Volazj
face.text: Battlecry: Summon a 1/1 copy of each of your other minions.
face.flavorText: His whole job is yelling "Yogg-Saron comin'!"

face.name: 自然守护者弗蕾亚
face.text: 抉择：复制你的手牌；或者召唤所有其他友方随从的复制。

face.name: Freya, Keeper of Nature
face.text: Choose One - Duplicate your hand; or Summon copies of all other friendly minions.
face.flavorText: Good things come in pairs. Good things come in pairs.

face.name: 大法师阿鲁高
face.text: 每当你抽到一张随从牌，将一张它的复制置入你的手牌。
face.flavorText: 他的孩子们都管他叫啊呜高。

face.name: Archmage Arugal
face.text: Whenever you draw a minion, add a copy of it to your hand.
face.flavorText: His worgen children call him Archmage AROO-OO-OO-OO-gal.

face.name: 人偶大师多里安
face.text: 每当你抽到一张随从牌，召唤一个它的1/1复制。
face.flavorText: 小朋友都很好奇玩具盒里的抓痕都是从哪儿来的。

face.name: Dollmaster Dorian
face.text: Whenever you draw a minion, summon a 1/1 copy of it.
face.flavorText: The children were puzzled by the scratches covering the insides of their toy-boxes.

face.name: 傀儡大师多里安
face.text: 在你抽一张随从牌后，获取一张它的1/1且法力值消耗为（1）点的复制。
face.flavorText: 明面上，多里安是砰砰博士的手下；但我们都清楚是谁在操纵着傀儡……

face.name: Puppetmaster Dorian
face.text: After you draw a minion, get a 1/1 copy of it that costs (1).
face.flavorText: Though Dorian may officially be working under Dr. Boom, we all know who's really pulling the strings...

face.name: 摇滚教父沃恩
face.text: 战吼：复制你手牌中每个不同类型的随从牌各一张。
face.flavorText: 当场烤焦多位观众之后，沃恩的队伍重心不全在龙身上了。

face.name: Rock Master Voone
face.text: Battlecry: Copy each minion of a different type in your hand.
face.flavorText: After several audience members were burnt to a crisp, Voone's band became a lot less all-in on Dragons.

face.name: 恋旧风潮
face.text: 将所有随从变形成为来自过去的随机传说随从。
face.flavorText: 风潮不改旧传说，相看恍如昨。

face.name: Wave of Nostalgia
face.text: Transform ALL minions into random Legendary ones from the past.
face.flavorText: Ja, please don't freeze my minions. No stall, ja????

policies.capture: Freeze ordered original current copy materials before delivery; no recursive inclusion of new copies.
policies.cost: Pip uses the existing complete current unselected quote amount, without payment or modifier consumption.
policies.matching: Existing finite maximum bipartite assignment, one physical hand card per type, complete12 type universe; hand order is explicit local tie policy.
policies.choices: Printed hand choice TTN_940b then board TTN_940a; existing choose-both executes in that order with original captured hand and board.
policies.board: Existing active living ordinary minion selector, excluding self; ordinary current board copies, Vorazj 1/1 replacement.
policies.draw: Original physical draw record and current source are checked; original draw owner and minion type; current hand recipe for ordinary draws.
policies.Zai_edges: Capture original left/right physical cards, locally deduplicate the one-card case, ordinary copy append. Exact one-card multiplicity/placement remains a CN boundary.

uncertainties: No exact CN tie-selection calibration for duplicate/multiple minion types; deterministic existing maximum matching is explicit local policy.

Freya choice-only primary API returns no faces in all four complete saved responses; original complete local option records and matching printed root text support the local implementation, not a full primary option claim.
Dormant board group inclusion and choose-both ordering retain explicit local policies pending CN edge validation.
GIL_620 auto-cast minion draw has no accepted stored-entry policy and raises explicitly; ordinary actual minion draws are supported.
Zai single-card edge multiplicity and copy placement are explicitly local; public search did not establish a definitive official rule. No claim of exact CN calibration.
